task_transport: Native Markdown projection; tasks.json is an authoring contract, not claimed native ingest schema.
source_authority: Must be materialized by LAC-001 and LAC-006; observed snapshots do not grant launch authority.

parallelism.provider_model: Existing explicitly capability-probed configuration; no new model or fallback assumed.

model_screen.note: Initial finite cell ceiling follows latest retained runs; admit measured preparation separately; repeat cells only under the sealed experiment budget.

review_bounded.note: Reviewer availability is an external capability; timing out never grants review. Human work may be resumed as a separately leased packet.

writer_policy: Resource/owner leases and isolated task worktrees; serialized semantic/schema promotion and merge queue.
completion_policy: LAC-081 result verifier plus role-appropriate independent semantic/kernel/consistency evidence.
publication_policy: Prepared artifacts only until separately configured release action; no historical assets overwritten.
